issue.title: revert: restore completed-week planning metrics
issue.body:
## What changed
- remove the reconstructed queue/backlog metrics added in #141
- restore the Price Matrix to the simpler completed-week planning model from #140
- keep: discovered today, discovered this week, previous full week, started conversations and coverage %, empirical conversations per bot, needed bots, existing bots
- keep bot recommendations based on the previous completed week's actual started-conversation throughput

## Why
The queue values in #141 were reconstructed from observer first/last-seen intervals and could look more precise than the underlying data supported. The intended workflow is to keep market observation and conversation coverage simple and align bot price ranges with the market-stat price ranges instead.
